name: Crash-boundary recovery and independent-process admission

runtime.topology: one host, one local file-backed SQLite database per trial

configuration.crash_injection: os._exit from an independent child process
configuration.barrier: two independent writer processes released by parent after both signal ready

claim_ceiling: Application-process crash recovery and independent-process contention on one local host only. Not kernel crash/power-loss simulation, storage-fault testing, multi-host consensus, Holochain, cryptographic verifier validation, Rust qualification, or production settlement.
known_follow_up: Larger 5 crash repetitions x 10 race repetitions run exceeded the 120-second tool limit and is incomplete. Diagnose harness scaling and add per-worker timing/partial logs before increasing repetitions.
engine_gate: Local SQLite 3.46.1 is older than the upstream fix for the documented WAL-reset bug. Repeat on SQLite 3.51.3 or later, or a verified vendor backport, and add checkpoint-concurrency testing before stronger WAL/checkpoint claims.
